DSH and Google Chrome must already be installed."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Surface | Perception | Input |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Chromium | Playwright, CDP accessibility/DOM, frames, tabs, optional OCR | Ref-pinned navigation, "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"pointer, keyboard, forms, scroll, drag, upload |
| macOS | Accessibility tree first, Vision OCR for "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"semantic gaps, independent window capture | AX actions, targeted SkyLight/CoreGraphics, global HID o"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"nly without a target |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Every action returns a fresh bounded text observation. The model works with roles, names, values, st"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ate, geometry, and stable snapshot refs instead of assuming it can inspect screenshots. UI and OCR s"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"trings are explicitly untrusted data."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Background macOS control"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- Carries PID, WindowServer window ID, AX window frame, and element identity through every action.
-"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" Prefers semantic AX actions before coordinate input.
- Routes supported pointer and keyboard events"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" directly to the target process/window.
- Uses a click-through software cursor; targeted actions do "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"not move the physical pointer.
- Keeps post-action observation pinned to the previous target, even w"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"hile another app stays active.
- Falls back to public CoreGraphics or fails closed when a private ca"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"pability is unavailable."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Platform boundary"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"ScreenCaptureKit is public API. The optional background input path dynamically loads private SkyLigh"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"t symbols and is intended for Developer ID distribution, not the Mac App Store. Private APIs are uns"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"upported by Apple and can change between macOS releases."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"On macOS 26, Stage Manager may expose a shelved window only as a small WindowServer thumbnail. Const"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ructing a capture filter for that representation can abort inside SkyLight. DSH Computer Use detects"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" the geometry mismatch first, preserves AX observation, returns an explicit warning, and never stret"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ches a thumbnail into a fake full-window screenshot."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## DSH integration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The embedded package declares a DSH bundle in `package.json`. See documentation/di"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"stribution.md for the exact local and GitHub Actions flows."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## OCR languages and bounded desktop observations"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"OCR detects languages automatically by default. Set `ocrLanguages` on the `computer-use-host` config"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"uration to an ordered list of Vision language identifiers, for example `["zh-Hans", "en-US"]`, to pr"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"efer Simplified Chinese and English. The same setting applies to desktop capture, display fallback, "},{"id":"p37s4","text":"and browser OCR. Unsupported language identifiers produce an explicit OCR warning/error rather than "},{"id":"p37s5","text":"silently dropping text; supported languages depend on the installed macOS version."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Desktop AX traversal supports up to 64 levels and at most 2,000 nodes (`maxNodes` still defaults to "},{"id":"p38s2","text":"250 in the host). Depth/node cutoffs set `truncated` and include a warning. A bounded observation ma"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"y still omit controls; narrow the view or observe again instead of guessing refs."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"Development dependencies target DSH `0.2.1-alpha.1`; the earlier `0.1.0-rc.6` peer ranges remain acc"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"epted. This does not imply that every intervening DSH version or macOS runtime has been tested."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"## Tool contract"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"`computer_observe` returns `interactive`, `full`, or `changes` snapshots for `browser` and `desktop`"},{"id":"p41s2","text":", with optional query filtering and `auto | always | never` OCR."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"`computer_action` performs exactly one browser or desktop action and returns the post-action semanti"},{"id":"p42s2","text":"c state. Ref and coordinate actions require the latest `snapshot_id`; stale targets fail closed and "},{"id":"p42s3","text":"require another observation.
